about: pytest bindings for cases.json. Each case runs fixtures/<case id with '-' as '_'>.py unless 'fixture' names another file. 'place' is test (tests/test_case.py, the default) or production (shop/settings.py inside the owned package). 'profile' entries replace top-level keys of the base conformance profile. 'tier' picks the guarded tier for run-report cases (default t1).
